mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned copper-gold-molybdenum-silver porphyry in west-central Yukon, Dawson Range, ~300 km NW of Whitehorse. Development stage: submitted ESE Statement to YESAB on Oct 6, 2025 (Panel Review underway). 2022 Feasibility Study economics (prices Cu $3.60/lb, Au $1,700/oz, Mo $14/lb, Ag $22/oz): pretax NPV5% $5,768M, IRR 21.2%; after-tax NPV5% $4,059M, IRR 18.1%; initial capex $3,618M; 27-year mine life; 120,000 t/d mill + 25,000 t/d heap leach. Avg annual LOM production 163 Mlb Cu, 211 koz Au, 1,277 koz Ag, 15.1 Mlb Mo. Osisko Gold Royalties holds a 2.75% NSR. Rio Tinto is a strategic investor (investor rights agreement extended to Nov 30, 2026). C$86.3M bought-deal financing closed June 2026.
mines.processing: 120,000 t/d conventional mill (flotation for copper and molybdenum concentrates) + 25,000 t/d heap leach for gold-silver
